title: Quietly Yeasty Indian Hake Pie
description: A tender and light Indian dish featuring hake, made with yeast and enclosed in a crust, served in a molcajete.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yeast and warm water, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add flour, salt, and ghee to the bowl, mixing to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
In a pan, saute the onion and ginger until softened.
Add the hake pieces to the pan and cook until opaque.
Roll out the risen dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Place the hake mixture in the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border.
Fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the pie in a molcajete and bake for 25 minutes.
